description: This file defines a content field index provider for DateField in OrchardCore, including the index class and provider class with logic to map content items to index entries based on DateField presence.

classes.name: DateFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents an index entry for DateField with a nullable DateTime property.

classes.name: DateFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for DateField in content items, mapping content items to index entries based on presence of DateField.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to DateFieldIndex entries, including filtering out deleted or ignored types and handling content type definitions.
